text: The paper reports that the Outcome & Process Reward Model (OPRM), which integrates the strengths of both PRMs and ORMs, outperforms ORMs and PRMs. Follow-up experiments on the MetaMath/Math-Shepherd datasets show no significant improvement from adding ORM training examples, which the authors suggest may be because Math-Shepherd is already generated from final-answer rewards.
title: Outcome-and-process reward model (OPRM) outperforms ORMs and PRMs
